text:
sam: Seeing a failed restore in staging for tenant-42. Restore job r-8732 -> decrypt error from KMS: AccessDenied (GrantMissing).
anya: Which snapshot and CMK? Any recent rotations or RBAC prunes?
matt: Which service principal is doing the restore? We ran RBAC prune yesterday across backup-agent roles.
sam: snapshot s3://backups/staging/tenant-42/2026-03-20-02.tar.gz, metadata shows cmk alias/backup-cmk. CMK rotation completed ~10h ago. Restore runner uses role arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/backup-agent. Logs: `KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied: GrantMissing`.
leah: Checked audit: CloudTrail event id abc123 removed a grant on alias/backup-cmk for the backup-agent principal at 2718499000. That matches the prune job. Looks like prune removed active grants.
anya: Oof. Quick mitigation: reissue the grant for the restore-runner and retry. We should avoid long-lived grants though.
sam: Ok trying quick command (aws CLI):
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id alias/backup-cmk \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/backup-agent \
  --operations Decrypt Encrypt \
  --name "restore-grant-tenant42"
```
I'll create ephemeral grant and re-run restore.
matt: Please run and confirm. After restore succeeds we should add guardrails so prune job doesn't nuke grants for keys with active snapshots.
leah: Filing immediate ticket to stop prune runs until we patch. Also enabling an alert: when a CMK grant is deleted and there are snapshots tagged `retain-grant:true` or a restore job in progress, create a pager.
anya: Long term: implement ephemeral grant flow in restore orchestration (create-grant at start, retire-grant at end). Add a pre-check in prune to query snapshot metadata DB for pending restores. SQL snippet to list relevant snapshots: `SELECT snapshot_id, cmk_alias FROM snapshots WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days' AND status='available';`
sam: Running the command now. Also adding a temporary label/tag on all staging snapshots to prevent prune.
matt: We should also update our KMS usage model: store the key-encryption-key id in snapshot metadata so restore logic can reconcile which key alias/arn to request grants for.
rotations-bot: Scheduled CMK rotation for alias/backup-cmk completed at 2718400000, new key arn:arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/abcd-ef01.
leah: Good catch bot. Action items emerging: 1) stop prune job; 2) reissue necessary grants; 3) implement ephemeral grant flow; 4) add audit alert for grant deletions; 5) run 90-day snapshot audit for CMK mismatches; 6) tabletop with Eng-SRE + Backup owners. I'll create tickets and assign.
anya: Also add an invariant check in CI for prune: ensure `grant-presence >= 1` for CMKs referenced by snapshots before pruning.
sam: Grant created, retried restore. r-8732 -> status: success. :thumbsup:
matt: I'll lead the tabletop and prepare a mitigation script to create grants in bulk based on snapshot metadata.
leah: I'll update the oncall runbook: steps to triage KMS decrypt failures (check cloudtrail for GrantDelete events, run `aws kms list-grants --key-id`, create grant, retry restore), and add checklist for rotations days.
anya: One more improvement: use envelope encryption with per-snapshot data-key metadata so we can fall back to rewrapping if needed. That lowers blast radius for CMK rotations.
sam: Quick postmortem note: immediate root cause = RBAC/prune job removed grants on an active CMK; fix = reissue grant + modify prune logic.
leah: I'll schedule the 10am tabletop for tomorrow and open follow-up tickets. Leaving this thread open until PRs land.
